newsitem.title: UK: Unicorn buys Nimbus for 7.8 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: Unicorn buys Nimbus for 7.8 mln stg.

text.p: Unicorn International Plc said on Tuesday it would buy Nimbus Diamond Tool & Machine Co. Ltd and Nimbus Laser Services Ltd for 7.8 million stg.
The abrasive products manufacturer said in a statement that it would satisfy the acquisiton with cash and through the issue of 3.3 million ordinary shares.
It said that 2.8 million of these shares were being placed with institutional investors at 143p per share and the balance was going to the vendors.
Nimbus manufactures dry cutting products such as diamond saw blades, core drills and diamond segments for drills and saws.
